<circle cx="390" cy="39" fill="#e2e8f0" r="3.5"></circle>
<circle cx="390" cy="240" fill="#e2e8f0" r="3.5"></circle>
<!-- Three configurations of string on the left:
                 Left ceiling anchors:
                 a: at x = 70, drops down to rod end
                 b: at x = 150, drops vertically down
                 c: at x = 230, drops down-left
            -->
<!-- Rod: extends from left end to right end (390, 240) -->
<!-- Case b (horizontal standard): from (150, 240) to (390, 240) -->
<!-- The diagram shows the rod at different tilted angles or three strings to same rod:
                 Notice in handout: "以重量不計的細繩，懸掛成三種不同角度，如圖所示，則圖中 a、b、c 三條細繩的張力大小關係為："
                 Right end is suspended by vertical string. Left end suspended by a (tilted left), b (vertical), c (tilted right).
                 Let's draw the rod tilted, or show the three suspension strings a, b, c clearly!
            -->
<!-- Rod representation -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="8" x1="120" x2="390" y1="200" y2="240"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="14" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle" x="255" y="240">均勻桿 (重 W，長 L)</text>
<!-- String a: from ceiling (60, 39) down to left end (120, 200) -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="60" x2="120" y1="39" y2="200"></line>
<circle cx="60" cy="39" fill="#f59e0b" r="4"></circle>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="15" font-weight="800" x="80" y="110">a</text>
<!-- String b: from ceiling (120, 39) straight down to left end (120, 200) -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="120" x2="120" y1="39" y2="200"></line>
<circle cx="120" cy="39" fill="#e2e8f0" r="4"></circle>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="15" font-weight="800" x="130" y="110">b</text>
<!-- String c: from ceiling (180, 39) down-left to left end (120, 200) -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="180" x2="120" y1="39" y2="200"></line>
<circle cx="180" cy="39" fill="#a855f7" r="4"></circle>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="15" font-weight="800" x="160" y="110">c</text>
<!-- Rod Center of Gravity -->
<circle cx="255" cy="220" fill="#e2e8f0" r="5"></circle>
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-red)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" x1="255" x2="255" y1="220" y2="285"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" font-weight="700" x="265" y="280">W (重力)</text>
<!-- Right suspension string label -->
<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" x="405" y="140">右端懸繩</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" x="405" y="160">鉛直懸掛</text>
<!-- Right Box: Mathematical Proof of Invariance -->
<g transform="translate(450, 20)">
<text fill="#000000" font-size="15" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle" x="145" y="26">力矩平衡角度無關性證明</text>
<!-- Proof Content -->
<rect fill="none" height="135" rx="6" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" width="260" x="15" y="42"></rect>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" x="35" y="88">設桿傾角為 θ，長度為 L：</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-family="'Fira Code', monospace" font-size="13" x="35" y="110">T·L·cos θ = W·(L/2)·cos θ</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="14" font-weight="800" x="35" y="158">⇒ T = (1/2) W</text>
<!-- Summary Card Inside -->
<rect fill="none" height="95" rx="6" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" width="260" x="15" y="190"></rect>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" font-weight="700" x="25" y="238">兩端懸繩張力必等值對稱</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="15" font-weight="800" x="25" y="262">a = b = c = (1/2) W</text>
</g>
</svg>

title: 53. 【平衡 24】不均勻木桿分別提起與總重求解
content:
水平地面上置一不均勻的木桿 $AB$，長度為 $4\text{ m}$。若欲將 $A$ 端鉛直提起，至少需施力 $10\text{ kgw}$；若欲將 $B$ 端鉛直提起，至少需施力 $16\text{ kgw}$。則此木桿的重量約為若干 $\text{kgw}$？

依據力矩平衡方程式推導，此木桿的總重量約為多少 $\text{kgw}$？

A
$26\text{ kgw}$
B
$13\text{ kgw}$
C
$\sqrt{160}\text{ kgw}$
D
$\sqrt{80}\text{ kgw}$
E
$20\text{ kgw}$
svg:
<svg class="exam-diagram-svg" viewbox="0 0 760 340" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<defs>
<marker id="arrow-blue" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="8" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<marker id="arrow-red" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="8" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<marker id="arrow-green" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="8" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<pattern height="8" id="diag-hatch" patterntransform="rotate(45 0 0)" patternunits="userSpaceOnUse" width="8">
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2" x1="0" x2="0" y1="0" y2="8"></line>
</pattern>
</defs>
<!-- Case 1 (Left): Lifting A端 (B is pivot) -->
<g transform="translate(20, 10)">
<!-- Ground -->
<rect fill="url(#diag-hatch)" height="12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" width="320" x="10" y="220"></rect>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" x1="0" x2="340" y1="220" y2="220"></line>
<!-- Rod tilted: B at (290, 220), A at (70, 130). dx = 220, dy = -90. -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="7" x1="70" x2="290" y1="130" y2="220"></line>
<!-- Point A -->
<circle cx="70" cy="130" fill="#e2e8f0" r="5"></circle>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="15" font-weight="800" x="50" y="130">A</text>
<!-- Point B (Pivot) -->
<circle cx="290" cy="220" fill="#f59e0b" r="5"></circle>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="15" font-weight="800" x="305" y="225">B</text>
<!-- Force F_A = 10 kgw upwards -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-blue)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="70" x2="70" y1="130" y2="55"></line>
<!-- Center of Mass G: closer to B. Let distance from B be x.
                   Suppose x/L = 10/26 ~ 0.385.
                   G at: x = 290 - 220*0.385 = 205. y = 220 - 90*0.385 = 185.
              -->
<circle cx="205" cy="185" fill="#e2e8f0" r="4.5"></circle>
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-red)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" x1="205" x2="205" y1="185" y2="250"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" font-weight="700" x="215" y="245">W (重力)</text>
<!-- Equation 1 below -->
<rect fill="none" height="40" rx="6" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" width="290" x="25" y="245"></rect>
<text fill="#000000" font-family="'Fira Code', monospace" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" x="170" y="270">10 × 4 = W × x  ⇒  W·x = 40</text>
</g>
<!-- Case 2 (Right): Lifting B端 (A is pivot) -->
<g transform="translate(390, 10)">
<!-- Ground -->
<rect fill="url(#diag-hatch)" height="12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" width="320" x="10" y="220"></rect>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" x1="0" x2="340" y1="220" y2="220"></line>
<!-- Rod tilted: A at (50, 220), B at (270, 130). dx = 220, dy = -90. -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="7" x1="50" x2="270" y1="220" y2="130"></line>
<!-- Point A (Pivot) -->
<circle cx="50" cy="220" fill="#f59e0b" r="5"></circle>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="15" font-weight="800" x="35" y="225">A</text>
<!-- Point B -->
<circle cx="270" cy="130" fill="#e2e8f0" r="5"></circle>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="15" font-weight="800" x="285" y="130">B</text>
<!-- Force F_B = 16 kgw upwards -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-green)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="270" x2="270" y1="130" y2="55"></line>
<!-- Center of Mass G: distance from A is (4 - x) = 4 * (16/26) ~ 2.46.
                   G at: x = 50 + 220*(1 - 0.385) = 185. y = 220 - 90*(1 - 0.385) = 165.
              -->
<circle cx="185" cy="165" fill="#e2e8f0" r="4.5"></circle>
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-red)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" x1="185" x2="185" y1="165" y2="230"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" font-weight="700" x="195" y="225">W (重力)</text>
<!-- Equation 2 below -->
<rect fill="none" height="40" rx="6" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" width="300" x="20" y="245"></rect>
<text fill="#000000" font-family="'Fira Code', monospace" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" x="170" y="270">16 × 4 = W(4 - x) = 4W - 40</text>
</g>
<!-- Bottom summary banner -->
<rect fill="none" height="30" rx="6" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" width="400" x="180" y="300"></rect>
</svg>

title: 54. 【平衡 25】水平輕棒懸重與樞紐作用力
content:
如圖所示，一木棒長 $L$（重量可忽略不計），在距離牆壁 $\frac{2}{3}L$ 處懸掛一重量為 $W$ 之物體。木棒一端以一樞紐固定於鉛直牆上，另一端用細繩以與水平夾角 $30^\circ$ 懸於牆上使其維持水平平衡。則牆上樞紐作用於棒的作用力大小為：

依據力矩與合力平衡推導，牆上樞紐作用於棒之力為多少？

A
$\frac{1}{2}W$
B
$\frac{4}{3}W$
C
$\frac{3}{4}W$
D
$\frac{\sqrt{13}}{3}W$
E
$\frac{\sqrt{2}}{5}W$
svg:
<svg class="exam-diagram-svg" viewbox="0 0 760 360" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<defs>
<marker id="arrow-blue" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="8" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<marker id="arrow-red" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="8" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<marker id="arrow-green" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="8" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<marker id="arrow-purple" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="8" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<pattern height="8" id="diag-hatch" patterntransform="rotate(45 0 0)" patternunits="userSpaceOnUse" width="8">
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2" x1="0" x2="0" y1="0" y2="8"></line>
</pattern>
</defs>
<!-- Vertical Wall on Left: x = 90 -->
<rect fill="url(#diag-hatch)" height="300" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" width="25" x="65" y="25"></rect>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" x1="90" x2="90" y1="20" y2="330"></line>
<!-- Pivot A at (90, 220) -->
<circle cx="90" cy="220" fill="#f59e0b" r="7" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2"></circle>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="15" font-weight="800" x="60" y="225">A</text>
<!-- Horizontal Rod AB: from A(90, 220) to B(390, 220). Length L = 300 px. -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="8" x1="90" x2="390" y1="220" y2="220"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="14" font-weight="700" x="395" y="235">B</text>
<!-- String from B(390, 220) to Wall C(90, 46.8).
                 tan 30 = dy / dx = 173.2 / 300 ~ 0.577.
                 C is at y = 220 - 173.2 = 46.8.
            -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="390" x2="90" y1="220" y2="47"></line>
<circle cx="90" cy="47" fill="#e2e8f0" r="4.5"></circle>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" font-weight="700" x="75" y="45">C</text>
<!-- Angle 30 deg at B -->
<path d="M 330 220 A 60 60 0 0 1 340 191" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"></path>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" font-weight="700" x="315" y="205">30°</text>
<!-- Hanging Weight W: at distance 2/3 L = 200 px from A -> x = 290 -->
<circle cx="290" cy="220" fill="#f8fafc" r="4"></circle>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" x1="290" x2="290" y1="220" y2="280"></line>
<rect fill="none" height="35" rx="4" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" width="40" x="270" y="280"></rect>
<!-- Distance Dimension (2/3 L) -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2" x1="90" x2="290" y1="245" y2="245"></line>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2" x1="90" x2="90" y1="240" y2="250"></line>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2" x1="290" x2="290" y1="240" y2="250"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" font-style="italic" text-anchor="middle" x="190" y="260">2/3 L</text>
<!-- String Tension Force Vector T at B -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-blue)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="390" x2="270" y1="220" y2="151"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="14" font-weight="800" x="295" y="145">T = (4/3)W</text>
<!-- Pivot Force Components at A:
                 F_x to the right: F_x = 2*sqrt(3)/3 W ~ 1.155 W
                 F_y upwards: F_y = 1/3 W ~ 0.333 W
            -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-green)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" x1="90" x2="160" y1="220" y2="220"></line>
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-green)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" x1="90" x2="90" y1="220" y2="170"></line>
<!-- Total Pivot Force F diagonal up-right -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-purple)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3.5" x1="90" x2="160" y1="220" y2="170"></line>
<!-- Right Box: Free Body Diagram & Calculation -->
<g transform="translate(440, 20)">
<text fill="#000000" font-size="15" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle" x="150" y="26">力矩與力平衡推導</text>
<!-- Step 1 -->
<rect fill="none" height="80" rx="6" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" width="270" x="15" y="40"></rect>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" x="35" y="80">T·sin 30°·L = W·(2/3 L)</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-family="'Fira Code', monospace" font-size="13" x="35" y="102">T·(1/2) = (2/3)W  ⇒  T = (4/3)W</text>
<!-- Step 2 -->
<rect fill="none" height="85" rx="6" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" width="270" x="15" y="130"></rect>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" font-weight="700" x="25" y="150">2. 正交力平衡求樞紐分力：</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" x="35" y="172">水平：F_x = T·cos 30° = (2√3/3)W</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" x="35" y="195">鉛直：F_y = W - T·sin 30° = (1/3)W</text>
<!-- Step 3 -->
<rect fill="none" height="85" rx="6" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" width="270" x="15" y="225"></rect>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" font-weight="700" x="25" y="245">3. 合成樞紐總作用力 F：</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-family="'Fira Code', monospace" font-size="13" x="35" y="268">F = √(F_x² + F_y²)</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="15" font-weight="800" x="35" y="292">F = √(12/9 + 1/9) W = (√13/3)W</text>
</g>
</svg>

title: 55. 【平衡 26】均質木棒水平繫繩與樞紐作用力
content: 一均質木棒重 $W$，一端以樞紐接於天花板，一端以輕繩水平繫於牆壁上，如圖所示。若木棒與天花板夾 $37^\circ$ 角，則樞紐作用於木棒之力與繩上張力之比值為多少？
svg:
<svg class="exam-diagram-svg" viewbox="0 0 520 280" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<defs>
<!-- Arrow marker blue -->
<marker id="arrow-blue" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="7" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1 L 9 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<!-- Arrow marker amber -->
<marker id="arrow-amber" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="7" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1 L 9 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<!-- Arrow marker emerald -->
<marker id="arrow-emerald" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="7" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1 L 9 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<!-- Ceiling & wall pattern -->
<pattern height="12" id="hatch-ceiling" patterntransform="rotate(45 0 0)" patternunits="userSpaceOnUse" width="12">
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" x1="0" x2="0" y1="0" y2="12"></line>
</pattern>
</defs>
<!-- Background subtle rect -->
<rect fill="none" height="100%" width="100%"></rect>
<!-- Ceiling & Right Wall Structure -->
<!-- Ceiling fill -->
<rect fill="url(#hatch-ceiling)" height="25" opacity="0.3" width="410" x="70" y="20"></rect>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="70" x2="480" y1="45" y2="45"></line>
<!-- Right Wall fill -->
<rect fill="url(#hatch-ceiling)" height="200" opacity="0.3" width="30" x="450" y="45"></rect>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="450" x2="450" y1="45" y2="245"></line>
<!-- Ceiling hinge support -->
<rect fill="#334155" height="15" rx="2" width="30" x="110" y="30"></rect>
<circle cx="125" cy="45" fill="#64748b" r="7" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"></circle>
<!-- The uniform rod: length projection dx = 200, dy = 150 (37 deg) -->
<!-- Rod axis from (125, 45) to (325, 195) -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="10" x1="125" x2="325" y1="45" y2="195"></line>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="4" x1="125" x2="325" y1="45" y2="195"></line>
<!-- Pivot dot at (125, 45) -->
<circle cx="125" cy="45" fill="#e2e8f0" r="4"></circle>
<text fill="#000000" font-family="'Fira Code', monospace" font-size="13" font-weight="600" x="100" y="65">樞紐 O</text>
<!-- Angle 37 deg arc at ceiling -->
<path d="M 175 45 A 50 50 0 0 1 165 75" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="3,2" stroke-width="2"></path>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" x="175" y="72">37°</text>
<!-- Horizontal rope: from (325, 195) to wall (450, 195) -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" x1="325" x2="450" y1="195" y2="195"></line>
<!-- Small wall anchor bracket -->
<rect fill="#cbd5e1" height="10" width="5" x="445" y="190"></rect>
<!-- Midpoint Center of Mass (225, 120) -->
<circle cx="225" cy="120" fill="#e2e8f0" r="5"></circle>
<!-- Gravity vector W downward -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-emerald)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" x1="225" x2="225" y1="120" y2="200"></line>
<!-- Tension force arrow T on rod at (325, 195) pointing right -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-amber)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="325" x2="400" y1="195" y2="195"></line>
<!-- Hinge Force Components & Resultant F at O -->
<!-- Fx pointing left (opposing T) -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-blue)" stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="3,2" stroke-width="2" x1="125" x2="65" y1="45" y2="45"></line>
<!-- Fy pointing up (or downward on ceiling, but ceiling acts UP on rod) -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="3,2" stroke-width="2" x1="125" x2="125" y1="45" y2="0"></line>
<!-- Resultant F vector from (125, 45) pointing down-left? Wait: Fy is UP (+y in physical, -y in svg) -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-blue)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" x1="125" x2="70" y1="45" y2="15"></line>
<!-- Dimension / lever arm guides -->
<line opacity="0.4" stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="4,4" stroke-width="1" x1="125" x2="125" y1="45" y2="245"></line>
<line opacity="0.4" stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="4,4" stroke-width="1" x1="225" x2="225" y1="120" y2="245"></line>
<line opacity="0.4" stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="4,4" stroke-width="1" x1="325" x2="325" y1="195" y2="245"></line>
<!-- Horizontal arms at bottom -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" x1="125" x2="225" y1="235" y2="235"></line>
<!-- Vertical arm for T on the left/right -->
<line opacity="0.5" stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="3,3" stroke-width="1" x1="125" x2="125" y1="45" y2="195"></line>
<line opacity="0.5" stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="3,3" stroke-width="1" x1="325" x2="125" y1="195" y2="195"></line>
</svg>

title: 56. 【平衡 27】細桿偏離鉛垂線與釘子作用力
content: 一均勻細桿，長 $1\text{ 公尺}$，重量為 $W$。在距離其上端 $25\text{ 公分}$ 處以一釘子將此細桿釘在鉛直牆面上，使細桿可繞此釘子無摩擦地旋轉。今施一水平力 $F$ 於其上端，使細桿偏離鉛垂線 $\theta$ 角（$\theta < 90^\circ$），則在平衡時，釘子作用在細桿上力之量值為？
svg:
<svg class="exam-diagram-svg" viewbox="0 0 520 330" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<defs>
<marker id="arrow-blue" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="7" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1 L 9 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<marker id="arrow-amber" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="7" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1 L 9 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<marker id="arrow-emerald" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="7" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1 L 9 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<marker id="arrow-purple" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="7" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1 L 9 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
</defs>
<!-- Vertical Plumb Line (鉛垂線) -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="6,4" stroke-width="1.8" x1="260" x2="260" y1="20" y2="305"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" x="240" y="322">鉛垂線</text>
<!-- Inclined Rod: angle theta ~ 28 deg with vertical -->
<!-- Nail pivot at (260, 115) -->
<!-- Top end at (295, 45): arm = 25 cm -->
<!-- Midpoint CG at (225, 185): arm = 25 cm from nail (50 cm from top) -->
<!-- Bottom end at (155, 325): arm = 75 cm from nail (100 cm total) -->
<!-- Rod body -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="8" x1="160" x2="295" y1="315" y2="45"></line>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="3.5" x1="160" x2="295" y1="315" y2="45"></line>
<!-- Nail pivot dot -->
<circle cx="260" cy="115" fill="#f59e0b" r="6" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2"></circle>
<!-- Angle theta arc at nail between rod and plumb line -->
<path d="M 260 150 A 35 35 0 0 1 244 146" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"></path>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" x="245" y="140">θ</text>
<!-- Force F at top (295, 45) horizontal pointing right -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-purple)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="295" x2="385" y1="45" y2="45"></line>
<!-- Center of Mass (重心) at (225, 185) -->
<circle cx="225" cy="185" fill="#e2e8f0" r="5"></circle>
<!-- Gravity W at CG pointing down -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-emerald)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" x1="225" x2="225" y1="185" y2="265"></line>
<!-- Nail Reaction Force Components at (260, 115) -->
<!-- Rx to left = F -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-blue)" stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="3,3" stroke-width="2" x1="260" x2="190" y1="115" y2="115"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" x="175" y="105">R_x = F</text>
<!-- Ry upward = W -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-blue)" stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="3,3" stroke-width="2" x1="260" x2="260" y1="115" y2="45"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" x="220" y="75">R_y = W</text>
<!-- Resultant R vector -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-blue)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.8" x1="260" x2="190" y1="115" y2="45"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" x="160" y="45">R (釘子力)</text>
<!-- Arm annotations -->
<!-- Top segment 25 cm -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="2,2" stroke-width="1" x1="295" x2="260" y1="45" y2="45"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="11" x="290" y="90">25 cm</text>
<!-- CG segment 25 cm -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="2,2" stroke-width="1" x1="225" x2="260" y1="185" y2="185"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="11" x="225" y="135">25 cm</text>
</svg>

title: 57. 【平衡 28】斜立木棒拉繩與地面作用力
content:
如圖所示，掛重 $W = 25\text{ kgw}$，$OA$ 桿長 $3\text{ 米}$，與地面夾角為 $60^\circ$，$B$ 為其中點，其繩成水平。設桿重不計，則：
(1) 人的拉力應為多少 $\text{kgw}$ 方能平衡？
(2) 地面作用於木棒之力為多少 $\text{kgw}$？
(3) 作用力方向與地面之夾角為 $\theta$，$\tan\theta$ 為何？
svg:
<svg class="exam-diagram-svg" viewbox="0 0 540 320" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<defs>
<marker id="arrow-blue" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="7" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1 L 9 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<marker id="arrow-amber" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="7" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1 L 9 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<marker id="arrow-emerald" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="7" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1 L 9 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<marker id="arrow-rose" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="7" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1 L 9 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<pattern height="12" id="hatch-ground" patterntransform="rotate(45 0 0)" patternunits="userSpaceOnUse" width="12">
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" x1="0" x2="0" y1="0" y2="12"></line>
</pattern>
</defs>
<!-- Ground -->
<rect fill="url(#hatch-ground)" height="25" opacity="0.3" width="460" x="40" y="260"></rect>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="40" x2="500" y1="260" y2="260"></line>
<!-- Person standing at left -->
<g transform="translate(100, 160)">
<!-- Head -->
<circle cx="20" cy="15" fill="#94a3b8" r="9"></circle>
<!-- Torso -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="4" x1="20" x2="20" y1="24" y2="65"></line>
<!-- Legs -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="3" x1="20" x2="10" y1="65" y2="100"></line>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="3" x1="20" x2="30" y1="65" y2="100"></line>
<!-- Arms holding rope -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="3" x1="20" x2="42" y1="35" y2="40"></line>
<circle cx="42" cy="40" fill="#f59e0b" r="3"></circle>
</g>
<!-- Hinge O on Ground at (270, 260) -->
<path d="M 255 260 L 285 260 L 275 250 L 265 250 Z" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"></path>
<circle cx="270" cy="252" fill="#f59e0b" r="6" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2"></circle>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" x="250" y="278">O</text>
<!-- Rod OA: angle 60 deg with ground, length = 200 px -->
<!-- dx = 200 * cos(60) = 100, dy = 200 * sin(60) = 173 -->
<!-- O is at (270, 252), A is at (370, 79) -->
<!-- Midpoint B is at (320, 165) -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="9" x1="270" x2="370" y1="252" y2="79"></line>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="4" x1="270" x2="370" y1="252" y2="79"></line>
<!-- Point A top -->
<circle cx="370" cy="79" fill="#e2e8f0" r="4"></circle>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" x="382" y="82">A</text>
<!-- Point B midpoint -->
<circle cx="320" cy="165" fill="#f59e0b" r="5"></circle>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" x="328" y="160">B (中點)</text>
<!-- Horizontal rope from B(320, 165) to person's hands (142, 165) -->
<!-- Wait, translate(100,160) arms are at 100+42=142, 160+40=200. Let's make rope perfectly horizontal at y=200 -->
<!-- Let's adjust B: midpoint y = 165. Let's adjust person arms to y = 165 -->
<!-- Ground angle 60 deg arc at O -->
<path d="M 305 252 A 35 35 0 0 0 287 222" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"></path>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" x="302" y="240">60°</text>
<!-- Horizontal rope to B -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" x1="142" x2="320" y1="200" y2="200"></line>
<!-- Note: if B is at y=200, let's mark B at y=200 (distance along rod = 60/173 * 3 = 1m? Let's keep rope at y=165 and adjust person) -->
<!-- Actually, let's connect rope from person (142, 200) to B(320, 165) or make rope horizontal at y=165 -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" x1="142" x2="320" y1="165" y2="165"></line>
<!-- Tension vector T on rod pointing left -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-amber)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="320" x2="230" y1="165" y2="165"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" x="260" y="152">T (拉力)</text>
<!-- Weight hanging at A -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8" x1="370" x2="370" y1="79" y2="155"></line>
<rect fill="#334155" height="35" rx="3" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" width="40" x="350" y="155"></rect>
<!-- Ground reaction force components at O(270, 252) -->
<!-- Fx to right -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-blue)" stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="3,3" stroke-width="2" x1="270" x2="340" y1="252" y2="252"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" x="320" y="270">F_x = T</text>
<!-- Fy upward -->

title: 65. 【平衡 36】均質棒斜倚垂直壁與三力共點幾何
content:
如圖所示，一均質棒 $AB$ 重 $W$，$B$ 端以細繩繫於鉛直壁 $C$ 點上，另一端 $A$ 則倚靠於鉛直壁且位於 $C$ 點之正下方。

已知 $\overline{AB}=\overline{AC}$，平衡時棒與鉛直壁成 $\alpha$ 夾角。下列敘述哪些正確？（多選）
svg:
<svg class="exam-diagram-svg" style=" border-radius: 8px;" viewbox="0 0 540 380">
<defs>
<marker id="arr-c" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="7" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1.5 L 8 5 L 0 8.5 z" fill="#000000"></path>

</marker>

</marker>

</marker>
</defs>
<!-- Vertical Wall -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="5" x1="120" x2="120" y1="40" y2="340"></line>
<!-- Wall hatchings -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" x1="100" x2="120" y1="60" y2="80"></line>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" x1="100" x2="120" y1="120" y2="140"></line>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" x1="100" x2="120" y1="180" y2="200"></line>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" x1="100" x2="120" y1="240" y2="260"></line>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" x1="100" x2="120" y1="300" y2="320"></line>
<!-- Points: A=(120, 280), C=(120, 80) => length AC = 200 -->
<!-- Rod AB: angle alpha with wall. Let alpha = 50 deg.
                 length AB = 200. B = (120 + 200*sin(50), 280 - 200*cos(50)) = (120 + 153.2, 280 - 128.5) = (273, 151) -->
<!-- String BC: from C(120, 80) to B(273, 151) -->
<!-- Midpoint of BC is D: D = ((120+273)/2, (80+151)/2) = (196.5, 115.5) -->
<!-- Midpoint of AB is E: E = ((120+273)/2, (280+151)/2) = (196.5, 215.5) -->
<!-- String BC -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="6 3" stroke-width="3" x1="120" x2="273" y1="80" y2="151"></line>
<!-- Tension arrow along BC towards C -->
<line marker-end="url(#arr-r)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="196.5" x2="145" y1="115.5" y2="92"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" x="145" y="75">張力 T</text>
<!-- Rod AB -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="7" x1="120" x2="273" y1="280" y2="151"></line>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="3" x1="120" x2="273" y1="280" y2="151"></line>
<!-- Angle alpha at A -->
<path d="M 120 230 A 50 50 0 0 1 152 253" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"></path>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" x="135" y="240">α</text>
<!-- Gravity line from E(196.5, 215.5) down and up to D -->
<circle cx="196.5" cy="215.5" fill="#e2e8f0" r="5"></circle>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" x="205" y="222">E (中點)</text>
<!-- Vertical line passing through E and D -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="4 3" stroke-width="2" x1="196.5" x2="196.5" y1="90" y2="300"></line>
<line marker-end="url(#arr-y)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="196.5" x2="196.5" y1="215.5" y2="290"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" x="205" y="285">重力 W</text>
<!-- Line AD: Median of isosceles triangle CAB -->
<!-- D is (196.5, 115.5) -->
<circle cx="196.5" cy="115.5" fill="#e2e8f0" r="5"></circle>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" x="205" y="115">D (三力共點)</text>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="4 3" stroke-width="2.5" x1="120" x2="235" y1="280" y2="33"></line>
<!-- Vector R along AD -->
<line marker-end="url(#arr-g)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3.5" x1="120" x2="180" y1="280" y2="151"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" x="110" y="170">作用力 R</text>
<!-- Right-angle mark at D between AD and BC -->
<rect fill="none" height="12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" transform="rotate(-25 196.5 115.5)" width="12" x="195" y="115"></rect>
<!-- Right-side Formula / Properties Card -->
<g transform="translate(300, 40)">
<rect fill="none" height="230" rx="8" stroke="#000000" width="220" x="0" y="0"></rect>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" x="14" y="26">幾何與力學核心關鍵</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" x="14" y="55">1. △CAB 為等腰 (AB = AC)</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" x="14" y="80">2. ED // 鉛直壁 AC 且 E 為中點</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="11" x="28" y="100">⇒ D 必為 BC 之中點！</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" x="14" y="125">3. 等腰底邊中線 AD ⊥ BC</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="11" x="28" y="145">⇒ 向量 R 必垂直張力 T！</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" x="14" y="175">4. 閉合直角力三角形：</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" x="28" y="195">T² + R² = W²</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" x="28" y="215">R = W cos(α/2)</text>
</g>
<!-- Point Labels -->
<text fill="#000000" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" x="100" y="290">A</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" x="100" y="80">C</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" x="285" y="155">B</text>
</svg>

title: 67. 【平衡 38】均勻木棍斜靠光滑半球面的切點力矩

<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" x="275" y="110">O (球心)</text>
<!-- Bowl Edge B at (400, 120) -->
<!-- Angle theta = 25 deg.
                 Chord AB passes through B=(400, 120).
                 Length of chord AB = 2R * cos(theta) = 240 * cos(25) = 240 * 0.9063 = 217.5.
                 Slope angle is 25 deg:
                 A is down-left from B:
                 dx = -217.5 * cos(25) = -197.1 => x_A = 400 - 197.1 = 202.9.
                 dy = 217.5 * sin(25) = 91.9 => y_A = 120 + 91.9 = 211.9.
                 Let's check distance to O(280, 120):
                 (202.9 - 280)^2 + (211.9 - 120)^2 = (-77.1)^2 + (91.9)^2 = 5944 + 8445 = 14389.
                 R^2 = 120^2 = 14400. EXACT! Point A lies perfectly on the circular bowl!
            -->
<!-- Rod extending beyond B: total length ell = 320.
                 From A(203, 212) along 25 deg:
                 Top end: x = 203 + 320*cos(25) = 203 + 290 = 493.
                 y = 212 - 320*sin(25) = 212 - 135 = 77.
            -->

<line stroke="#000000" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="4" x1="203" x2="493" y1="212" y2="77"></line>

<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" x="445" y="112">θ</text>
<!-- Normal force P from bowl rim at B: perpendicular to rod pointing up-left -->
<!-- Slope of rod is -tan(25) = -0.466. Normal has slope 1/tan(25) = 2.144 (pointing up-left)
                 dx = -60*sin(25) = -25.3, dy = -60*cos(25) = -54.4 -->
<line marker-end="url(#arr-g)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3.5" x1="400" x2="365" y1="120" y2="45"></line>
<!-- Right angle at B between rod and force P -->
<rect fill="none" height="10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" transform="rotate(25 400 120)" width="10" x="390" y="110"></rect>
<!-- Center of gravity of rod: distance ell/2 = 160 from A.
                 C = (203 + 160*cos(25), 212 - 160*sin(25)) = (203 + 145, 212 - 68) = (348, 144) -->

title: 76. 【平衡 47】輪軸加速吊升與物體繩張力矩【105指考】

title: 77. 【平衡 48】斜傾木棒樞紐施力方向與夾角範圍
content:
如圖所示，有一木棒上端以樞紐固定於牆角，木棒中間懸掛一重物 $W$，且木棒下端以一水平細繩固定於右側垂直牆面。

設木棒與鉛直線之夾角為 $\theta$（$0^\circ < \theta < 90^\circ$）。若樞紐施予木棒之力 $F$ 的方向與鉛直線之夾角為 $\alpha$，則夾角 $\alpha$ 可能為下列何者？
svg:
<svg class="exam-diagram-svg" style=" border-radius: 8px;" viewbox="0 0 540 370">
<defs>
<marker id="arr-c" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="7" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1.5 L 8 5 L 0 8.5 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<marker id="arr-g" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="7" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1.5 L 8 5 L 0 8.5 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<marker id="arr-r" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="7" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1.5 L 8 5 L 0 8.5 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<marker id="arr-y" markerheight="6" markerwidth="6" orient="auto-start-reverse" refx="7" refy="5" viewbox="0 0 10 10">
<path d="M 0 1.5 L 8 5 L 0 8.5 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
</defs>
<!-- Ceiling / Wall Corner -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="4" x1="80" x2="300" y1="120" y2="120"></line>
<!-- Right Vertical Wall -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="4" x1="420" x2="420" y1="80" y2="340"></line>
<!-- Corner Hinge O = (300, 120) -->
<circle cx="300" cy="120" fill="#e2e8f0" r="7" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"></circle>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" x="312" y="115">樞紐 O</text>
<!-- Vertical reference dashed line down from O -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="4 3" stroke-width="1.5" x1="300" x2="300" y1="50" y2="320"></line>
<!-- Rod OB: angle theta with vertical. Let theta = 45 deg.
                 length ell = 180.
                 Bottom B = (300 + 180*sin(45), 120 + 180*cos(45)) = (300 + 127, 120 + 127) = (427, 247).
                 Wait, wall is at x=420. Let's make wall at x=440.
                 B = (400, 260) with dx=100, dy=140.
            -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="8" x1="300" x2="400" y1="120" y2="260"></line>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="4" x1="300" x2="400" y1="120" y2="260"></line>
<!-- Angle theta with vertical -->
<path d="M 300 170 A 50 50 0 0 0 328 159" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"></path>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" x="312" y="185">θ</text>
<!-- Midpoint M = (350, 190) with hanging weight W -->
<circle cx="350" cy="190" fill="#e2e8f0" r="5"></circle>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" x1="350" x2="350" y1="190" y2="270"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" x="358" y="215">中點重物</text>
<!-- Horizontal string from B(400, 260) to right wall (440, 260) -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="5 3" stroke-width="3" x1="400" x2="440" y1="260" y2="260"></line>
<line marker-end="url(#arr-r)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="400" x2="435" y1="260" y2="260"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" x="375" y="285">水平繩張力 T</text>
<!-- Hinge Force F pointing up-left:
                 Vertical component Fy = W (upwards)
                 Horizontal component Fx = T (leftwards)
                 Since tan(alpha) = T / W = 1/2 tan(theta), alpha < theta.
                 Vector from O(300, 120) pointing up-left:
                 dx = -80, dy = -110 -->
<line marker-end="url(#arr-g)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3.5" x1="300" x2="225" y1="120" y2="40"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" x="175" y="45">F (樞紐力)</text>
<!-- Angle alpha with vertical upward dashed line -->
<path d="M 300 75 A 45 45 0 0 0 270 73" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"></path>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" x="268" y="65">α</text>
<!-- Formula note -->
<g transform="translate(40, 160)">
<rect fill="none" height="130" rx="6" stroke="#000000" width="190" x="0" y="0"></rect>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" x="12" y="24">力矩與力平衡聯立</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="11" x="12" y="48">對 O 點列力矩：</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="11" x="24" y="66">T = ½ W tan θ</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="11" x="12" y="88">樞紐力分解：tan α = T / W</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" x="24" y="108">tan α = ½ tan θ</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="11" x="12" y="124">⇒ 0° < α < θ</text>
</g>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" x="408" y="255">B</text>
</svg>

title: 78. 【平衡 49】雙斜面夾光滑圓球的受力分析
content: 右圖為一質量均勻之光滑圓球，將它置於 $A$、$B$ 兩光滑斜面間呈平衡。已知球重為 $W$，斜面 $A$ 仰角 $\theta_1 = 30^\circ$、斜面 $B$ 仰角 $\theta_2 = 60^\circ$（兩斜面自同一起點出發），則斜面 $A$、$B$ 作用於球的力各為何？
svg:
<svg class="exam-diagram-svg" viewbox="0 0 540 380" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<defs>
<lineargradient id="wedgeGrad" x1="0%" x2="100%" y1="0%" y2="100%">
<stop offset="0%" stop-color="#3b82f6" stop-opacity="0.2"></stop>
<stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1d4ed8" stop-opacity="0.05"></stop>
</lineargradient>
<radialgradient cx="40%" cy="40%" id="sphereGrad" r="60%">
<stop offset="0%" stop-color="#60a5fa" stop-opacity="0.8"></stop>
<stop offset="60%" stop-color="#2563eb" stop-opacity="0.9"></stop>
<stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1e3a8a" stop-opacity="1"></stop>
</radialgradient>
<marker id="arrowRed" markerheight="10" markerwidth="10" orient="auto" refx="8" refy="3">
<path d="M0,0 L0,6 L9,3 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<marker id="arrowGreen" markerheight="10" markerwidth="10" orient="auto" refx="8" refy="3">
<path d="M0,0 L0,6 L9,3 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<marker id="arrowCyan" markerheight="10" markerwidth="10" orient="auto" refx="8" refy="3">
<path d="M0,0 L0,6 L9,3 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
</defs>
<!-- Ground -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" x1="40" x2="490" y1="330" y2="330"></line>
<!-- Hatch marks -->
<path d="M50,330 l-10,12 M80,330 l-10,12 M110,330 l-10,12 M140,330 l-10,12 M170,330 l-10,12 M200,330 l-10,12 M230,330 l-10,12 M260,330 l-10,12 M290,330 l-10,12 M320,330 l-10,12 M350,330 l-10,12 M380,330 l-10,12 M410,330 l-10,12 M440,330 l-10,12 M470,330 l-10,12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"></path>
<!-- Vertex at (100, 330) -->
<!-- Surface A: angle 30 deg. Ray from (100, 330) length 380: dx = 380*cos(30) = 329, dy = -380*sin(30) = -190 => (429, 140) -->
<!-- Surface B: angle 60 deg. Ray from (100, 330) length 340: dx = 340*cos(60) = 170, dy = -340*sin(60) = -294 => (270, 36) -->
<polygon fill="url(#wedgeGrad)" points="100,330 270,36 100,36" stroke="none"></polygon>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3.5" x1="100" x2="280" y1="330" y2="18"></line>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3.5" x1="100" x2="450" y1="330" y2="128"></line>
<!-- Angle arcs at vertex -->
<!-- theta 1 = 30 deg -->
<path d="M160,330 A60,60 0 0,0 152,300" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"></path>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" x="175" y="322">θ₁=30°</text>
<!-- theta 2 = 60 deg -->
<path d="M190,330 A90,90 0 0,0 145,252" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"></path>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" x="125" y="240">θ₂=60°</text>
<!-- Sphere resting between A and B -->
<!-- Sphere radius R = 60. Center calculated to touch both lines -->
<!-- Let origin be (100, 330). Line 1 at 30 deg, Line 2 at 60 deg. Bisector is at 45 deg. -->
<!-- Distance from vertex to center = R / sin(15 deg) = 60 / 0.2588 = 231.8 -->
<!-- Center C: x = 100 + 231.8 * cos(45) = 100 + 163.9 = 264, y = 330 - 163.9 = 166 -->
<circle cx="264" cy="166" fill="url(#sphereGrad)" opacity="0.95" r="62" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5"></circle>
<circle cx="264" cy="166" fill="#ffffff" r="4"></circle>
<!-- Labels for Surface A and Surface B -->
<text fill="#000000" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" x="390" y="150">斜面 A (30°)</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" x="210" y="50">斜面 B (60°)</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" x="264" y="155">球心 C (重 W)</text>
<!-- Force vectors from center C(264, 166) -->
<!-- 1. Gravity W downward -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrowRed)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="264" x2="264" y1="166" y2="280"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" x="275" y="275">W (重力)</text>
<!-- 2. Normal force N_A from surface A (angle 30°): perpendicular is 30+90 = 120° (up-left) -->
<!-- dx = -85 * cos(30) = -73.6, dy = -85 * sin(30) = -42.5? Normal is perpendicular to line at 30°, so angle is 120°: dx = 85*cos(120) = -42.5, dy = -85*sin(120) = -73.6 -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrowGreen)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="264" x2="190" y1="166" y2="38"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" x="145" y="45">N_A = √3 W</text>
<!-- 3. Normal force N_B from surface B (angle 60°): perpendicular is 60-90 = -30° (down-right from surface pointing to center) -->
<!-- Force on sphere from B points along normal (angle -30° or 330° or from right pointing up-left? Wait: surface B is steeper than A, so surface B is to the left/upper side of sphere? -->
<!-- At C, surface B is at 60°, which is above the bisector (45°). So surface B is to the UPPER-LEFT of the sphere! -->
<!-- Normal from surface B to sphere points DOWN-RIGHT: angle = 60° - 90° = -30° (i.e. dx > 0, dy > 0). -->
<!-- Vector N_B pointing down-right: dx = 85*cos(30) = 73.6, dy = 85*sin(30) = 42.5 => (338, 208) -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrowCyan)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="264" x2="338" y1="166" y2="209"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" x="345" y="215">N_B = √3 W</text>
<!-- Contact points dashed normals -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="3,3" stroke-width="1.5" x1="264" x2="295" y1="166" y2="220"></line>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="3,3" stroke-width="1.5" x1="264" x2="210" y1="166" y2="197"></line>
</svg>

title: 79. 【平衡 50】雙斜面支撐均勻木棒與物體位置
content: 有一長度 $4\text{ m}$、重量 $2\text{ kgw}$ 的均勻棒子，兩端分別用兩個光滑斜面支撐（左側斜面仰角 $60^\circ$、右側斜面仰角 $30^\circ$）。今在棒子上方置一重量 $8\text{ kgw}$ 的物體，恰可使棒子成「水平」的靜止平衡狀態，如圖所示，則該物體與棒子 $B$ 端的距離為多少 $\text{m}$？
svg:
<svg class="exam-diagram-svg" viewbox="0 0 540 360" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<defs>
<marker id="arrowRed" markerheight="10" markerwidth="10" orient="auto" refx="8" refy="3">
<path d="M0,0 L0,6 L9,3 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<marker id="arrowGreen" markerheight="10" markerwidth="10" orient="auto" refx="8" refy="3">
<path d="M0,0 L0,6 L9,3 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<marker id="arrowCyan" markerheight="10" markerwidth="10" orient="auto" refx="8" refy="3">
<path d="M0,0 L0,6 L9,3 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
<marker id="arrowOrange" markerheight="10" markerwidth="10" orient="auto" refx="8" refy="3">
<path d="M0,0 L0,6 L9,3 z" fill="#000000"></path>
</marker>
</defs>
<!-- Ground reference dashed line -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="4,4" stroke-width="1.5" x1="50" x2="490" y1="310" y2="310"></line>
<!-- Valley of two inclined planes meeting at (210, 310) -->
<!-- Left incline: angle 60° to horizontal. From (210, 310) going up-left: dx = -140, dy = -140 * tan(60°) = -242 => (70, 68) -->
<!-- Right incline: angle 30° to horizontal. From (210, 310) going up-right: dx = 280, dy = -280 * tan(30°) = -161 => (490, 149) -->
<polygon fill="#1e293b" opacity="0.6" points="70,68 210,310 490,149 490,310 70,310"></polygon>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="5" x1="70" x2="210" y1="68" y2="310"></line>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="5" x1="210" x2="490" y1="310" y2="149"></line>
<!-- Angle labels -->
<path d="M170,310 A40,40 0 0,1 190,275" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"></path>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" x="140" y="295">60°</text>
<path d="M260,310 A50,50 0 0,0 253,285" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"></path>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" x="268" y="300">30°</text>
<!-- Horizontal rod AB at y = 170 -->
<!-- Left contact with 60° slope: x = 210 - (310-170)/tan(60°) = 210 - 140/1.732 = 210 - 80.8 = 129.2 -->
<!-- Right contact with 30° slope: x = 210 + (310-170)/tan(30°) = 210 + 140*1.732 = 210 + 242.5 = 452.5 -->
<!-- Rod AB: x from 129 to 452.5 (length in px = 323.3, representing 4 m) -->
<rect fill="#64748b" height="12" rx="4" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" width="324" x="129" y="166"></rect>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" x="110" y="155">A</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" x="460" y="155">B</text>
<!-- Center of rod: x = (129 + 453)/2 = 291 -->
<!-- Rod weight 2 kgw -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrowRed)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" x1="291" x2="291" y1="178" y2="245"></line>
<circle cx="291" cy="172" fill="#ef4444" r="3"></circle>
<!-- Object 8 kgw at x: distance from B is 0.75m -> (0.75/4) * 323 = 60.6 px to the left of B (452 - 61 = 391) -->
<rect fill="#e2e8f0" height="30" rx="3" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" width="36" x="373" y="136"></rect>
<!-- Object gravity arrow -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrowRed)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="391" x2="391" y1="178" y2="255"></line>

title: 80. 【平衡 51】起重機臂吊物與鋼索張力矩平衡
content: 如圖為起重機示意圖，起重機臂 $PO$ 和水平線的夾角為 $60^\circ$，且可繞 $O$ 點自由轉動，其質量為 $200\text{ kg}$ 且分布均勻；鋼索 $PS$ 段和水平線的夾角為 $30^\circ$，$PSO$ 位於同一垂直面。起重機臂右端懸掛一質量為 $160\text{ kg}$ 的重物，若此時處於平衡狀態，且整條鋼索質量可忽略不計，則鋼索上的張力是多少 $\text{N}$？（取重力加速度 $g = 10\text{ m/s}^2$）

<!-- Let's check: S=(160,300). Line SP has angle 30° to horizontal. -->
<!-- Line OP has angle 60° to horizontal. Point P is above between S and O or right of O? -->
<!-- In P.33 diagram: S is at bottom left, O is at bottom right, P is peak! -->
<!-- SP goes up-right with 30° from S. PO goes up-left with 60° from O! -->
<!-- Let S=(130, 300). Let O=(390, 300). Distance SO = 260. -->
<!-- In triangle PSO: angle at S = 30°, angle at O = 60°! -->

title: 83. 【摩擦 3】疊合楔形木塊與桌面間摩擦力分析
content: 水平桌面上有 $A$、$B$ 兩塊楔形木塊堆疊在一起，呈靜止狀態。已知 $A$、$B$ 兩楔形木塊的重量分別為 $w$ 及 $3w$，斜面傾角為 $30^\circ$，如圖所示。則地面（桌面）與木塊 $B$ 間的摩擦力為多少？

title: 84. 【摩擦 4】斜面滑輪系統保持靜止之質量比範圍
tags: 91年研究試題・雙向滑動臨界
content: 如圖所示，在傾斜角為 $\theta$ 的固定斜面上，將質量為 $m$ 的甲物體，以質量可以不計的細繩，繞過無摩擦之滑輪後，與質量為 $M$ 的乙物體連接。若斜面與甲物體間的靜摩擦係數為 $\mu$，而甲與乙均保持靜止不動，則可確定其質量比 $M/m$ 必為下列何者？

title: 89. 【摩擦 9】跨越平台與斜面繩子自滑之摩擦係數
content: 如附圖所示，一均勻的繩子跨置於水平平臺與傾角 $37^\circ$ 的斜面交界處。當其總長度的 $\frac{1}{3}$ 停於水平平臺上（其餘 $\frac{2}{3}$ 垂於斜面上）時，繩子恰可向下滑動。設平臺與斜面的摩擦係數均相同為 $\mu$，則此摩擦係數為多少？

title: 90. 【摩擦 10】等加速滑動與動摩擦係數計算

title: 91. 【摩擦 11】正立方體滑動與轉動同時臨界條件

title: 92. 【摩擦 12】楔形木塊地面摩擦力判斷
content:
將一三角形（楔形）木塊置於粗糙水平地面，再將一方形物體放置於三角形木塊之斜面上，如圖所示。

試判斷下列三種假設情況下三角形木塊受到地面的摩擦力是否為零：

  • 情況甲：物體靜止於斜面；
  • 情況乙：物體沿斜面等速下滑；
  • 情況丙：物體沿斜面等加速下滑。

（三種情況中三角形木塊均維持靜止）

title: 93. 【摩擦 13】斜面上兩方塊水平推力分析

title: 94. 【摩擦 14】物體下滑與斜面維持靜止條件
content:

若物體沿光滑斜面下滑，欲使木塊保持靜止，則三角形木塊底面與地面間的靜摩擦係數 $\mu_s$ 至少應為多少？（設重力加速度 $g = 10\text{ m/s}^2$）

title: 95. 【摩擦 15】堆疊楔形木塊砝碼滑動判斷
content:
水平桌面上置有 A、B 兩塊楔形木塊，呈靜止狀態，如圖所示。A、B 木塊的重量分別為 $2\text{ kgw}$ 與 $4\text{ kgw}$，A 與 B 接觸面的靜摩擦係數為 $\mu_s = 0.8$。

title: 96. 【摩擦 16】木棒細繩繫牆臨界摩擦係數
content:
有一均勻木棒，一端置於水平地面上，另一端以水平細繩繫至一鉛直牆壁，使木棒與地面夾 $\theta$ 角，如圖所示。

若已知 $\tan\theta = 3/4$，則木棒與地面之間的靜摩擦係數 $\mu_s$ 至少應為多少，木棒才不會滑動？

<svg class="exam-diagram-svg" viewbox="0 0 540 320" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

title: 100. 【摩擦 20】斜面總作用力恆定性分析
content: 將重量為 $W$ 的物體置放於一粗糙斜面上，已知物體與粗糙斜面間靜摩擦係數為 $\mu_s$，物體與粗糙斜面間動摩擦係數為 $\mu_k$，將斜面的斜角 $\theta$ 由零度漸漸增加到 $\theta_0$，但物體仍未沿斜面下滑，則在此過程中，下列敘述何者正確？

title: 101. 【摩擦 21】圓柱受力與參考點力矩平衡

title: 102. 【摩擦 22】鑷子夾球受力分析與臨界摩擦
content:
獲得 2018 年諾貝爾物理學獎的科學家對雷射領域做出的重要貢獻，包括了光學鑷子在物理學上的應用，本題將探討傳統鑷子的原理：

用兩邊長各為 $L$、末端重合成 V 字形的鑷子，去夾半徑為 $R$、質量為 $m$ 的玻璃小球。夾小球時，鑷子在鉛直面上，若每邊對小球施力量值為 $F$，恰可將小球夾起，鑷子與小球的接觸點如圖所示。設重力加速度為 $g$：

  • (1) 試畫出小球所受各外力的力圖（需標示各外力的名稱）。
  • (2) 計算出鑷子與小球之間的靜摩擦係數 $\mu$ 至少為若干？
svg:
<svg class="exam-diagram-svg" viewbox="0 0 540 340" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<!-- Central Vertical dashed symmetry axis -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="4 3" stroke-width="1.5" x1="270" x2="270" y1="20" y2="320"></line>
<!-- Tweezers V-shape: vertex at (270, 30) -->
<!-- Half angle theta approx 15 deg.
                 Left arm: from (270, 30) to (210, 260) -> length ~ 238
                 Right arm: from (270, 30) to (330, 260)
            -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="4" x1="270" x2="210" y1="30" y2="260"></line>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="4" x1="270" x2="330" y1="30" y2="260"></line>
<!-- Sphere: center on symmetry axis at (270, 230), radius R = 50 -->
<circle cx="270" cy="230" fill="none" r="50" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5"></circle>
<circle cx="270" cy="230" fill="#e2e8f0" r="4"></circle>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" x="275" y="225">球心</text>
<!-- Angle theta at top vertex -->
<path d="M 260 70 A 40 40 0 0 1 280 70" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"></path>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" x="250" y="85">θ</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" x="276" y="85">θ</text>
<!-- Contact points at perpendicular normal:
                 Angle of left normal from sphere center is 15 deg above horizontal (165 deg).
                 Left contact: cx + R*cos(165) = 270 - 48.3 = 221.7, cy - R*sin(165) = 230 - 12.9 = 217.1
                 Right contact: cx + 48.3 = 318.3, cy = 217.1
            -->
<circle cx="222" cy="217" fill="#ef4444" r="4.5"></circle>
<circle cx="318" cy="217" fill="#ef4444" r="4.5"></circle>
<!-- Normal force F on ball: pointing into center (270, 230) -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-red-22)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" x1="180" x2="220" y1="206" y2="216.5"></line>
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-red-22)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" x1="360" x2="320" y1="206" y2="216.5"></line>
<!-- Friction force fs(max): along the tweezer arm UPWARDS -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-green-22)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="222" x2="236" y1="217" y2="165"></line>
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-green-22)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="318" x2="304" y1="217" y2="165"></line>
<!-- Gravity mg: from (270, 230) pointing DOWN -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-purple-22)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" x1="270" x2="270" y1="230" y2="305"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" x="278" y="300">mg (重力)</text>
<!-- Dimensions L and R labels -->
<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" x="220" y="130">L</text>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="13" x="315" y="130">L</text>
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-dasharray="3 2" stroke-width="1.5" x1="270" x2="318" y1="230" y2="217"></line>
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" x="290" y="222">R</text>
<defs>
<marker id="arrow-red-22" markerheight="8" markerwidth="8" orient="auto" refx="7" refy="4">
<polygon fill="#ef4444" points="0 0, 8 4, 0 8"></polygon>
</marker>
<marker id="arrow-green-22" markerheight="8" markerwidth="8" orient="auto" refx="7" refy="4">
<polygon fill="#e2e8f0" points="0 0, 8 4, 0 8"></polygon>
</marker>
<marker id="arrow-purple-22" markerheight="8" markerwidth="8" orient="auto" refx="7" refy="4">
<polygon fill="#a855f7" points="0 0, 8 4, 0 8"></polygon>
</marker>
</defs>
</svg>

title: 103. 【摩擦 23】雙箱滑輪連接等速移動分析
tags: 講義 靜力學-39 (完結篇)
content:
在水平地面上，以不可伸長的細繩繞過定滑輪，將質量分別為 $m_1$、$m_2$ 的上、下兩個均質箱子連接如圖。已知重力加速度為 $g$，細繩與滑輪之間無摩擦力，且其質量均可忽略，下箱之上、下表面的動摩擦係數皆為 $\mu$。

若下箱受到水平拉力 $F$ 時，兩箱不轉動，均以等速度水平移動，則下列敘述哪些正確？（多選）
svg:
<svg class="exam-diagram-svg" viewbox="0 0 540 320" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<!-- Ground -->

<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" x1="270" x2="380" y1="158" y2="158"></line>
<!-- String bottom: from pulley bottom (380, 202) to m2 right side (340, 202) -->
<line stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" x1="380" x2="340" y1="202" y2="202"></line>
<!-- Pulling Force F on m2 (to the left): at (160, 210) -->
<line marker-end="url(#arrow-red-23)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3.5" x1="160" x2="80" y1="210" y2="210"></line>
<!-- Friction forces indicators -->
<!-- Between m1 and m2 -->
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" x="180" y="195">動摩擦 μ</text>
<!-- Between m2 and floor -->
<text fill="#000000" font-size="12" x="210" y="255">動摩擦 μ</text>

<marker id="arrow-cyan-23" markerheight="8" markerwidth="8" orient="auto" refx="7" refy="4">
